weeks.shortDescription:
Welcoming back Medicine Muzic, founder and resident DJ of OMGarden, a monthly sacred dance event.
Serving as co-facilitator for Mount Shasta's Ecstatic Dance for many years. He travels globally, sharing his signature sound alongside visionary artists, musicians, and producers. Brian describes his music as a journey through mystical, ambient, tribal, and psychedelic spaces.
His sets move from deep, organic tribal house to global sounds spanning Meso-American Medicine Music, World Music, ie: African, Latin, Eastern Indian & Brazilian, Electronic Bass Music, Reggae, Drum N Bass, Dubstep, Hip Hop, and
sacred frequencies—all intended to uplift, heal, and expand consciousness. "I see all of it as healing medicine music".
weeks.bio:
A pioneering force in the San Francisco house and electronic music realm. As one of the founders of the legendary Remedy SF events, he produced transformational experiences for over two decades, DJing for 15 years and bringing some of the world's most respected artists to the stage.
Brian's journey began in 1990, during the rise of rave culture, when the rhythms of electronic music became a form of soul awakening. The foundational values of the movement, Peace, Love, Unity, and Respect resonated deeply, inspiring him to dedicate his life to music, community, and creating spaces that uplift consciousness.
Over time, the call to step behind the decks and craft his own music became undeniable, and Medicine Muzic was born. Following a period of personal transformation and spiritual awakening, Brian relocated to mystical Mount Shasta, known as the root chakra of the planet, to explore the healing power of music and dance in deeper ways. This path led him into the heart of conscious music festivals, ecstatic dance, and spiritually-driven sound experiences.

weeks.somaticBlurb:
Restorative/Yin Aerial Yoga from Kailyn Bailey
A regular teacher at Tula 

“As we move into the darker half of the year that shifts us more inward. I want for offer a moment of pause, relaxation and restoration before we move into our ceremony. Deep stretches with light mobility will soften, open and prepare your body for dance.

Aerial yoga adds a playful and fun element to traditional yoga. Using the silk hammock to aid in deeper stretches, inversions, and strengthening muscles without strain all while building new neural pathways. The silk hammock offers gentle swaying that adds a calming stress relief element to our practice. It is accessible to all levels of yogis, and can help those achieve poses that may be more challenging on their own. Inversion therapy does wonders for spinal decompression, and blood flow while providing a fascia massage.”
-Kailyn

Our weekly eDance offers a facilitated movement experience called Soma Lab.
It’s included in the regular cost of entry.

weeks.bio: In a broader sense for all DJ Owlchemy sets, it's a deep privilege to be inspired by Central Oregon, a land of lava rock, juniper and sage, vast mountain horizons, and wild rivers. This landscape carries a quiet power that inspires reflection, transformation, and reverence for life. Each journey is crafted with intention, moving through moments of stillness, depth, rhythm, power, reflection, and celebration. This is more than simply playing songs for a dance floor. It’s a shared space for beauty, authenticity, and self-remembrance

CYRENITY is a multidimensional music artist, DJ, and ceremonial sound healer crafting immersive dance journeys that bridge devotion, bass, synths, and deep inner awakening.

She curates conscious dance floors that move through play, beauty, connection, and sensuality, weaving yummy EDM, dirty bass, expansive house, ethereal world textures, melodic techno, and spiritual tribal music with her etheric vocals and original productions—cultivating deeper connection through sound, movement & spirit.
